prompts.default: Game environment raster asset. Rounded chunky hand-painted cartoon, soft dark purple-brown outlines, ONLY 2–3 clear flat shade levels, simple broad shapes, small brief highlights. Match chibi fantasy actors. NO photographic texture, noise, micro-detail, airbrush shading, black outlines, text, labels, frames or watermark. Materials: rounded chunky natural cave rock; local palette: pale purple crystal sand and violet stone, subtle cyan mineral veins. Seamless walkable floor material, full bleed, uniform soft light, no directional cast shadows, no vignette, no walls or standing objects. Square top-down packed earth, very few rounded FLAT pebble inclusions, broad low-contrast patches, no grid. A lightly worn cleaner walking surface, same palette and brightness as main ground, no continuous path stripe.
